tools.name: get_website_audit_offers
tools.description: List current website audit tiers and pricing. Read-only and creates no charge.

tools.name: prepare_website_audit_checkout
tools.description: After the human explicitly agrees to pay, prepare the selected secure checkout for the supplied website. Checkout creation is not payment proof.

tools.name: get_website_audit_order_status
tools.description: Use the Stripe Checkout Session ID returned by the paid flow to independently verify payment. For the $49 Quick Win Audit, this also returns the automatically generated bounded audit result when available.
